# truenas_static_route (Data Source)

Fetches a TrueNAS static route by destination.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `destination` (String) Destination network in CIDR notation to look up, e.g. "10.20.0.0/16".

### Read-Only

- `description` (String)
- `gateway` (String)
- `id` (Number) Numeric static route ID assigned by TrueNAS.
